## When ARGUS suggests it

The NOAA solar radiation storm level is S2 or higher, or the ≥100 MeV proton alert is on [SRC_NOAA_SWPC_PROTONS]. When to shelter is a demo policy [SRC_DEMO_RADIATION_MODEL].

## Steps

1. Move to the shelter location. [SRC_STD3001_RAD]
2. Wear your dosimeter. [demo wording]
3. Reduce EVA (spacewalks). [SRC_STD3001_RAD]
4. Log your time in shelter. [demo wording]
5. Follow the Earth radiation team's instructions. [demo wording]
6. Send a report to the flight surgeon. [demo wording]
